# Episode 22: The keeper of Hatch Lock

Guest: Dev Rao, lock keeper.

- 02:10 The lock keeper's cottage was built in 1840, the year the lock was widened.
- 05:40 About ninety boats pass on a summer Saturday.
- 08:50 The paddles are greased every Monday at seven.
- 12:25 The quietest days are Tuesdays in February.
